profile.name: Abhishek Anand
profile.summary: Full-stack software engineer specializing in scalable backend systems, Java, Spring Boot, and AWS cloud infrastructure. Experienced in API security, microservices architecture, and real-time observability.

highlights: Built and deployed cloud-native services on AWS (Lambda, EC2, VPC, S3, DynamoDB, CloudWatch) and integrated Okta-based authentication/authorization into application workflows.
Designed PostgreSQL and Redis schemas for efficient data access, and performed performance monitoring and debugging of services using Splunk, Honeycomb, and OpenTelemetry.
Contributing to an enterprise migration from a monolithic architecture to microservices using Java, Spring Boot, and Angular deployed across Azure/CentOS.
Integrated Next.js and React frontend modules with RESTful APIs in an Agile environment.
Built full-stack features using Spring Boot REST microservices, Spring MVC presentation layer, and MySQL persistence via JDBC/JPA.
Validated proficiency in core Java 17, OOP design patterns, SQL optimization, and algorithms through multi-stage FSE technical assessments.
Acquired extensive knowledge in cybersecurity, cloud computing, and data engineering, enhancing technical skills relevant to Accenture's projects.
Gained practical experience in application security, network fundamentals, and web application security, supporting both B2B and B2C service development.
Built a strong foundation in ITIL 4, RPA, and end-to-end cyber risk management, contributing to robust software development and operations.

projects.title: MayoCity
projects.subtitle: Full-Stack Job Board & AI Moderation
highlights: Built full-stack job board connecting job seekers and employers with advanced search and CSV bulk imports.
Implemented secure admin authentication and an AI-assisted moderation dashboard using Google Gemini API.
Designed a scalable REST API with PostgreSQL persistence and real-time data fetching (SWR), deployed on Vercel.

projects.title: Kafka
projects.subtitle: Full-Stack Hotel Management & Staff Task PWA
highlights: Built a modular, zero-framework Progressive Web Application (PWA) with offline caching via Service Workers and an Apple-inspired minimalist design system.
Implemented secure JWT authentication with Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) for managers and staff, supporting bulk CSV import/export for employee directory management.
Architected a Node.js and Express REST API backed by PostgreSQL (Neon DB) featuring live task monitoring, status lifecycle tracking, and dynamic pagination.

projects.title: VectorShift
projects.subtitle: Visual Workflow Builder
highlights: Built a drag-and-drop pipeline builder supporting 9 node types via a declarative configuration system.
Implemented FastAPI backend validating pipeline graphs with DAG cycle detection and topological execution.

projects.title: Bloom
projects.subtitle: Interactive Syllabus & Prep Progress Tracker
highlights: Built an interactive prep tracking web app supporting multi-track syllabi (DSA, System Design, Competitive Exams) loaded dynamically from decoupled JSON datasets.
Implemented real-time progress calculations with sticky progress headers, status filtering (All / To Do / Done), and live search across topics.
Designed a custom searchable track dropdown component and client-side persistence using LocalStorage for uninterrupted session state.
